observedBehavior: Publisher offers x86 and x64 variants.
Publisher only claims operation from Windows Vista RTM through Windows 7 RTM and disclaims confidence on later versions because the utility relies on system internals.
The product's driver is unsigned; publisher instructions require boot-time disabling of driver-signature enforcement to load it.
The tool lists kernel-mode filters and can unregister them.

publisherPages.observedPublisherHistory: The 2009 product article documents callback/filter removal and cautions the tool had not been fully tested; the x64 version was tested on Windows 7 RTM.

publisherPages.observedPublisherUpdate: The October 21, 2009 update says version 1.1.0 added restoration for some unregistered Create Process, Thread and Load Image callbacks.

acquisition.attemptedRetrieval: The official link click resolved to https://ntcore.com/files/FilterMon.zip but returned Cache miss before archive bytes.

notes: This source review records technical compatibility and retrieval facts. It does not retire or exclude Filter Monitor and does not introduce a licensing gate.
